fusions.name: Timber
fusions.desc: Brings the edge down along a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 28 slashing damage to every enemy in it. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Poll and Bit
fusions.desc: Strikes with the flat of the head, then the edge: deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Peened Edge
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Felling Notches
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a notch builds on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per notch. Unfed, a notch fades every 4 seconds.
